title: Retro Bowl
intro: Retro Bowl is a football game that puts you in charge of managing a team. In this retro-style game, improve your team and build a legacy as you train players, upgrade facilities and, of course, play some football!
description:
About Retro Bowl

Control offensive play, improve your team and create a legacy that can last for over 100 seasons if you manage your team well.

Poki is the official home of the only licensed Retro Bowl web version. Play it for free now and start building your dream team.

Retro Bowl cheats

The pro Retro Bowl players use advanced techniques that, if mastered, will let you play as if you are using cheat codes.

Find the 4 most common Retro Bowl cheats below:

  • Dive to gain ground: Diving forward will give you a guaranteed 2 yards. Use this to your advantage at the goal line or 3rd & short.
  • Improve WR catching: Aim slightly past your WR when using the bullet pass to increase his odds of catching the ball.
  • Gain ground with your RB: Instead of running with your RB, wait until they are open, then toss the ball to them. This will let you gain up to 5 yards each time.
  • Improve low star players: This one is specifically for QBs and receivers. QBs reliably complete 3-5 yard throws, while low star receivers consistently catch short passes. This is a great way to quickly gain ground.

Retro Bowl pro tips

You win in Retro Bowl by reading the field and reacting fast. You don't win by spamming deep throws. It comes from choosing the right option on every snap. Discover our tips below to play Retro Bowl like a pro.

Passing and scoring

Choosing the right pass matters more than throwing far. Know which throw fits the situation:

  • Short throws (5–10 yards): The safest option. Keeps drives alive and limits interceptions.
  • Medium throws: Best when a receiver beats a single defender cleanly.
  • Deep throws: Only take these when coverage fully breaks.

Throw the ball before the receiver finishes the route. Early throws create space and reduce interception risk. Waiting too long lets defenders close the gap.

Most winning drives come from throws of 10 yards or less. Deep passes only work when your receiver clearly separates. If two defenders are already in position, take the short gain and reset the play.

Clock control basics

Clock control wins tight games.

Short passes and early dives let you drain time without losing yards.

When leading, aim to score with under 30-35 seconds left in the second and fourth quarters. This makes it very difficult for the opposing team to gain enough ground before the half ends.

If you trail late, throw toward the sideline to stop the clock. Every second matters.

Building the best team

You build strong teams through strategic upgrades. Managing a limited roster and your players' star ratings decides whether you can sustain winning seasons.

Start with smart player upgrades. Here are the most important payers to focus on upgrading first:

  • Quarterback: Improves timing and control.
  • Wide receivers: Create safer throwing windows.
  • Running back: Adds control late in games.

Manage salary caps

You start with a salary cap of $150 million which is not enough to manage an entire team of 5 star players. So it's important to build a balanced team of offensive players to give your QB time to play and defensive players to help you out of tight situations.

You will be able to increase the cap to $175m by spending 100 Coaching Credit. But this will take 2-4 seasons to get.

Drafting, trading and releasing players

You control long-term success through team management. Top Retro Bowl players review their teams often to succeed.

  • Draft: You need long-term value and cap space. Aim to draft younger players as they cost less and grow faster.
  • Trade: You must trade if a player's cost is about to become too high.
  • Release: When a player no longer fits your playstyle, it's time to release them. A change in your strategy should be reflected in your team's strengths.

Retro Bowl features

Retro Bowl is as much about playing football as it is about managing your team, upgrading facilities, improving morale of players and coaches and keeping your fans happy.

Core gameplay

  • Offensive Control: You control every offensive play. Timing and team management decide whether a drive continues or ends.
  • Weather Effects: Rain and wind make passing harder. This forces you to adjust throw power, aim safer routes, and avoid risky deep balls.
  • Play Calling: Audibles and timeouts let you react when the defence shows something unexpected, helping you stay in control mid-drive.

Team management

  • Roster Management: Draft, trade, and sign players under the $150m salary cap. Balancing here keeps multiple options open when plays break down.
  • Player Morale: Low morale causes players to drop passes and miss throws. It can also impact the overall team morale if one player is particularly bad.
  • Training: Improve your players' strength, stamina, kicking, and throwing. Each upgrade increases their star rating over time.
  • Coaching Credits: By winning games you will earn Coaching Credits. These credits are used to upgrade everything in the game from the stadium, to staff hires and player attributes.
  • Fan ratings: Keeping fans happy directly impacts how many Coaching Credits you will receive after winning a game. Higher support (66-100%) gives you 3 CC, mid-range (33-66%) gives 2 CC, and low support (0-33%) gives 1 CC.

Progression & goals

  • Career Mode: Each season builds on the last. Smart upgrades make games easier over time, while bad decisions force tough rebuilds.
  • Exhibition Game: Use an Exhibition Game to test plays and strategies without consequences on your career. The Retro Bowl 2 player mode is also found here. This can be accessed in the settings screen.
  • Hall of Fame: The Hall of Fame lets you permanently save player stats so that you can view them even after they have retired. This is also where you view your achievements and statistics.

How to play Retro Bowl

Here is how to play Retro Bowl on both desktop and mobile.

On desktop:

  • Throwing: Drag and hold with the left mouse button to aim the direction of the throw. Release the mouse to throw it.
  • Dodging: Use W and S on the keyboard to move up and down to avoid other players.
  • Passing: Click and hold on a receiver to pass the ball to them.
  • Diving: Use A on the keyboard to dive forward when running.
  • Slowing down: Use D on the keyboard to stall your movement.
  • Kicking: Manage your kick power by clicking when the power meter is full. Then manage the direction by clicking when the arrows are aligned in the middle.

On mobile:

  • Throwing: Tap and hold on a receiver/player to pass the ball. Drag your finger to aim before releasing.
  • Dodging: Swipe up or down to dodge while running with the ball.
  • Passing: Tap and hold on a receiver to pass the ball to them.
  • Diving: Swipe forward to dive for extra yards, with a risk of losing momentum.
  • Slowing down: Swipe backward to hesitate or slow down temporarily.
  • Kicking: Manage your kick power by tapping the screen when the power meter is full. Then manage the direction by tapping when the arrows are aligned in the middle.

Game modes

Retro Bowl offers 5 game modes, each changing how much timing and control you need to win.

Game mode What changes Who it's for
Easy, medium & hard modes These 3 modes have varying levels of difficulty that impact the skill of your opponents and how aggressive their defence is. Easy: For new players. Medium: For players seeking a well-balanced game. Hard: For players seeking a real challenge.
Extreme mode Here, all opponents will play with a 5-star rating. This requires near-perfect timing and smart clock management. This game mode is reserved for the real pros of Retro Bowl.
Dynamic mode This will adjust the difficulty automatically as you play. The difficulty increases as you win more and decreases as you lose. This is good for players seeking a challenge to match their skills.

Who created Retro Bowl?

Retro Bowl was released in January 2020 for iOS and Android by New Star Games. The web version was released on Poki in 2021 and was an instant hit. Since then, it has received almost 1 million upvotes from our players.

Retro Bowl unblocked

Poki has an official website where you can play Retro Bowl Unblocked.

The Retro Bowl app

Retro Bowl has a dedicated mobile app for both iOS and Android.

More Retro games to play

If you enjoy the mix of retro style and fast football action in Retro Bowl, try Retro Bowl College where you manage a college football team instead of taking on the big leagues.

If you want quicker matches and more immediate action, 4th and Goal 2024 delivers classic American football plays with faster pacing.

For short, high-pressure moments, 2-minute-football-classic focuses on clutch decisions where every second counts.
